name: Santillana del Mar (Spain)
description: Red field with two green diagonal bands fimbriated yellow from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged in the upper hoist with the crowned arms of Santillana del Mar (a saint on red, in an ornate frame).
history: Municipal flag of Santillana del Mar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: two bands edged yellow from the lower hoist to the upper fly
